user_story:
As a user, I want to log in to my bank account so that I can access my banking services. 
Acceptance Criteria: 
1. The login form must include a username input field with the selector 'input[name="username"]'. 
2. The login form must include a password input field with the selector 'input[name="password"]'. 
3. The login button must be visible and clickable with the selector 'input[value="Log In"]'. 
4. After successful login, the user should be redirected to the homepage.
